status: fixed before any foundation-model inference on CARE; owner decisions of 2026-10-17

inherits.unchanged: split and folds; availability = record time + 600 s; common-support definition (status0 in calibration); calibration floor of 512 scores and the 70%/30% prefix split; score max(abs(y - p50)/R) over the two temperatures; per-method 99.5% calibration threshold with strict >; OPEN/CLOSE after 3 consecutive; gap/file-end reset; primary hit; false-alarm counting; primary metrics; native-support baseline

data_status: the CARE test has been read and the own model's per-event outcomes are saved: development material, not an unknown holdout; no business pass/fail or production decision. The foundation-model settings (128 context, p50, 99.5%, adapter defaults) are taken verbatim from the inherited contract and the existing adapters, not chosen from the saved outcomes
training_statement: zero-shot inference and per-method threshold calibration update no parameters and are not training; R0.2's stop on other real-data training stays

methods.own_model: saved SmallForecaster 5-fold predictions, thresholds and alarms; no retraining, re-inference or retuning
methods.baselines: saved load-bin temperature medians, common and native support

foundation_models.name: TimesFM 3
foundation_models.use_restriction: the weights licence excludes commercial decision-making: TimesFM results are a research reference only and do not feed the owner's later thresholds or adoption decision

foundation_model_protocol.training: none (zero-shot), existing adapters in src/banto_ai/adapters/, pinned packages and checkpoint revisions
foundation_model_protocol.input_boundary: CARE contexts through care_input.Consumer (past-only context, no_truth guard); 128 past rows [n-128, n) of the 3 signals in native units; adapter timestamps = 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z + file-local offset seconds, 600 s interval; no backend uses calendar features
foundation_model_protocol.roles: TimesFM and Chronos: the two temperatures are targets and power is a past-only covariate, no known-future covariates; Toto: all three signals are variates and only the two temperatures are used
foundation_model_protocol.adapter_defaults: TimesFM use_znorm=False, padding_mode='none', univariate=False; Chronos cross_learning=False; Toto: 128 rows = 4 patches, no padding or MISSING mask
foundation_model_protocol.request: horizon 1, quantiles [0.5] only; alarms use the lead-1 p50 as in the inherited contract
foundation_model_protocol.support: the own model's common-support rows only
foundation_model_protocol.score_scale: R = the fold's train-only MAD x 1.4826 read from <fold root>/input.json profile.alarm_scales[v].R64 of the closed fold root, not recomputed, identical for every method
foundation_model_protocol.calibration: per fold, the inherited calibration segment (last 30% of the validation anchor prefix), same score, per-method 99.5% threshold, same alarm rules; fewer than 512 calibration scores is a stop, not a threshold

failures.row_unsupported: a row-level ValueError from an adapter (e.g. nonfinite output) makes that row unsupported for that method, recorded and never filled; in the alarm it acts as the inherited gap (closes an open episode, resets counters) and leaves the false-alarm denominator; unsupported counts reported per method and fold; more than 1% unsupported in any method/fold stops for investigation before acceptance
failures.stop: any other failure (model load, process crash, memory or time overrun) stops; only the harness may be fixed and the unit re-run; no change of inputs, context length, thresholds or support after results exist

metrics.inherited: asset-macro recall, false episodes per 1000 normal record-hours, normal alarm-time fraction, earliness with misses counted; counts, pooled, per event, per asset, support
metrics.lead_time_rule: W in hours converted to W*3600 s on the file-local availability clock; an event is detected at W if its primary hit (the first episode newly OPENed inside the shifted [event_start, event_end]) OPENs at or before shifted event_end - W; W = 0 is the inherited primary hit; episodes active before the start never count at any W (reported separately as inherited) and later OPENs inside the window never count; event_end is not guaranteed to be the failure time, so the lead time is a proxy
false_alarm_units: per asset per 30 days (720 record-hours), a linear rescale of the rate, per asset and pooled; some normal assets have fewer than 720 eligible record-hours
metrics.per_event_table: detection, OPEN time, lead proxy and attainability at every W, for every method and anomaly event
metrics.significance: 12 anomaly events only: no significance claims
metrics.attainable: events whose shifted annotated duration (end - start) is shorter than W cannot be detected at W; the per-event table flags attainability at every W

acceptance: none in this run; the required lead time and the allowed false-alarm rate are set by the owner after seeing the comparison

execution.environment: separate Python environment per foundation model; record package versions and downloaded checkpoint revisions and hashes
execution.units: per fold, segment (calibration/test) and method, in fixed chunks of 1000 origins; each chunk closed and resumable; adapters infer one row per call, no batching
execution.parallel: independent units may run concurrently, at most 3 processes (4 cores)
execution.rows: about 118,841 per method (71,007 calibration + 47,834 test common-support)
execution.freeze_then_score: save, hash and freeze predictions, scores, thresholds and alarms of every method and fold; only then the evaluator reads the labels; scoring first checks that the saved own-model and baseline metrics reproduce
execution.storage: CARE-derived inputs, predictions and labels stay in the gitignored artifacts/; only hashes and summaries are committed

out_of_scope: longer contexts, other covariate treatments, fine-tuning, the official CARE score
